title: What role does family play in occupational therapy?
metaTitle: The Role of Family in Occupational Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: The involvement of family in occupational therapy is key to improving outcomes in children with Autism. Learn how Pinnacle Blooms integrates family in therapy programs.
html: The role of family in occupational therapy is a critical one. At Pinnacle Blooms, we believe that families are essential team members. They provide valuable insights, support and can facilitate therapy practices at home, making the therapeutic intervention more coherent and effective. Hence, our therapists work closely with families, guiding them about the progress their child is making, and providing necessary training for home-based activities that complement therapy sessions.
